There are three primary pieces of [[Necromancer]] only ShadowBound armor. You will need to collect the following items and turn them in to [[Syllina]] in [[The Temple of Solusek Ro]].

== Rewards ==

<ul><li>  {{:ShadowBound Boots}}
</li><li> {{:ShadowBound Gloves}}
</li><li> {{:Robe of Enshroudment}}
</li></ul>

== ShadowBound Boots =={{CheckboxList}}
* [[Scepter|Scepter of Sorrow]] (in [[Mistmoore]] complete the [[Solusek's Flower]] subquest - turn in flower to [[Ssynthi]] to receive "a scepter")
* [[Skeletal Toe]] (drops off [[A_Giant_Skeleton|giant skeletons]] in [[Rathe Mountains]])
* [[Eye of Shadow]] (drops off [[A shadowed man]])
* [[Shadow Silk]] ([[Tailoring]] (Trivial: 36) - combine: 1 [[Gather_Shadows|Gather Shadows]] scroll, 1 [[Silk_Swatch|silk swatch]], 1 [[Shadow_Wolf_Pelt|shadow wolf pelt]])
{{End}}

== ShadowBound Gloves =={{CheckboxList}}
* [[Scepter|Scepter of Tears]] (ground spawn in [[Lower Guk]] - from "dead side" entrance, turn left at first T intersection and follow path down to waterfall and up to room where it spawns (Number 1 on Dead Side Map))
* [[Skeletal Finger]] (drops off [[A_Giant_Skeleton|giant skeletons]] in [[Rathe Mountains]])
* [[Hand of Shadow]] (drops off [[A shadowed man]])
* [[Inky Shadow Silk]] ([[Tailoring]] (Trivial: 36) - combine: 2 [[Gather_Shadows|Gather Shadows]] scrolls, 1 [[Silk_Swatch|silk swatch]], 1 [[Shadow_Wolf_Pelt|shadow wolf pelt]])
{{End}}

== Robe of Enshroudment =={{CheckboxList}}
* [[A Werebat Wing]] (drops off [[A_werebat|Werebats]] in [[Unrest]])
* [[Globe of Shadow]] (drops off [[A_froglok_nokta_shaman|A Froglok Nokta Shaman]] in [[Upper Guk]] - near "live side" entrance and [[Ancient Crocodile]] spawn (Number 3 on Live Side Map))
* [[Mask of Shadow]] (drops off [[A shadowed man]])
* [[Large Shadow Silk]] ([[Tailoring]] (Trivial: 36) - combine: 1 [[Gather_Shadows|Gather Shadows]] scroll, 1 [[Silk_Swatch|silk swatch]], 2 [[Shadow_Wolf_Pelt|shadow wolf pelts]])
{{End}}

== Walkthrough ==
You say, 'Hail, Syllina'

:Syllina says, 'Hello, I am Syllina, follower of Solusek Ro and keeper of the [Shadow Lore].'

You say, 'What Shadow Lore'

:Syllina says, 'I hold the secrets to the Shadow Lore so highly prized by Necromancers. If you are interested, I can tell you about [ShadowBound Boots], [ShadowBound Gloves], the [Robe of Enshroudment] or the secrets to the making of [Shadow Silk].'



'''ShadowBound Boots'''

You say, 'What ShadowBound Boots'

:Syllina says, 'ShadowBound Boots are boots woven from purest shadow. If you are interested, I will weave you a pair - but I will need [boot components].'

You say, 'What boot components'

:Syllina says, 'I will need the following items to make you a pair of ShadowBound Boots: Shadow Silk, The Scepter of Sorrow from Castle Mistmoore, an Eye of Shadow from our mortal enemies the Shadowed Men and a Skeletal toe from a Rathe Giant Skeleton.'



'''ShadowBound Gloves'''

You say, 'What ShadowBound Gloves'

:Syllina says, 'ShadowBound Gloves are gloves woven from the purest shadow. If you are interested, I will weave you a pair - but I will need [glove components].'

You say, 'What glove components'

:Syllina says, 'I will need the following items to make you a pair of ShadowBound Gloves: Inky Shadow Silk, The Scepter of Tears from the circle-stair-waterfall of Guk, a Hand of Shadow from our mortal enemies the Shadowed Men and a Skeletal finger from a Rathe Giant Skeleton.'



'''Robe of Enshroudment'''

You say, 'What Robe of Enshroudment'

:Syllina says, 'The Robe of Enshroudment is a robe woven from the purest of shadow. If you are interested, I will weave you a robe - but I will need the following [robe components].'

You say, 'What robe components'

:Syllina says, 'I will need the following items to make you a Robe of Enshroudment: Large Shadow Silk, A Werebat Wing from the Estate of Unrest, A Mask of Shadow from our mortal enemies the Shadowed Men and a Globe of Shadow from a Nokta Shaman in Guk.'



'''Shadow Silk'''

You say, 'What Shadow Silk'

:Syllina says, 'If you are interested, I will tell you the secrets of making Shadow Silk for a mere 50 pieces of gold.'
